title: Understanding KDE Bandwidth
text: The bandwidth in a KDE plot controls the smoothness of the distribution. A small bandwidth can lead to a plot that is too jagged, while a large bandwidth can oversmooth the data. Consider how this might affect the appearance of a multimodal distribution.

hintAnswer: The plot becomes oversmoothed, potentially hiding multiple peaks.
title: Effect of Bandwidth on KDE
text: What happens to a KDE plot if the bandwidth is too large?
choices: The plot becomes oversmoothed, potentially hiding multiple peaks.
The plot becomes too jagged, showing too many peaks.

title: Multimodal Distributions
text: A multimodal distribution has multiple peaks. If a KDE plot looks like a normal distribution, it might be because the bandwidth is too large, smoothing out these peaks.
